newsitem.title: USA: Novartis Seeds trimming back hybrid seed lines.
newsitem.headline: Novartis Seeds trimming back hybrid seed lines.

text.p: Novartis Seeds Inc, which was formed from the merger of Ciba Seeds and Northrup King Co, said Tuesday it will trim back its seed offerings to 80 top hybrids for the 1998 sales season.
This compares to the more than 200 separate corn hybrids sold by Ciba and Northrup in 1996.
Ciba and Northrup merged on January 1, 1997. Novartis Seeds is an affiliate of Novartis Seeds AG of Switzerland, which is part of Novartis AG.
"We finished this year's sales season as two separate companies so as not to confuse our customers," Don Jacoby, director of sales at Novartis Seeds, said in a statement.
Now, the company will sell its products as NK-brand seeds.
Novartis said its field crops division reported a first-quarter sales gain of 31 percent over 1996.
